title: Orthogonal crypto sleeves, round 4: mechanical flows (4 trials)

trials.A stablecoin mint shock: USDT+USDC market cap (Coin Metrics, used with the 2-day publication lag as C*): daily growth > +0.5% -> long BTC and ETH 0.5 each for the next 3 days (data to 2026-05-23 in the research file; flat after)
trials.B leverage crowding: BTC and ETH separately: 7-day open-interest value change > +15% AND 7-day mean funding > 0.03% per 8 h -> short that coin 0.5 for the next 3 days
trials.C weekend reversal XS: 60 coins: weekend return (Fri 00:00 -> Mon 00:00 UTC) ranked; long the losing third / short the winning third with inverse-vol legs, held Monday to Thursday
trials.D US-open seasonality: short BTC and ETH 0.5 each during the 13:00 and 14:00 UTC bars on US weekdays
